title: False positive: f-string SQL in test seed data uses constant values only
evidence: demo-store-api/tests/test_search.py:13 builds an INSERT with an f-string. The only values are the loop index `i` and `email` from SEED_EMAILS, a hardcoded list of constants (:7, :12). This is a test fixture (seed(), :10-14) that pytest calls on a temporary database (:18-20). It isn't part of the deployed app and takes no external input.
recommended_fix: No security fix is needed. Optionally use parameters (VALUES (?, ?, 10.0, 'OPEN')) for consistency, and exclude tests/ from this rule or suppress it there.
